study_identification.title: Detecting accelerated retinal decline in mental disorders through normative modeling

study_characteristics.study_objective: To build normative models of age-related macular retinal thickness (and sublayers RNFL, GC-IPL) in UK Biobank healthy controls and test whether schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and major depressive disorder show accelerated decline and deviations from the normative patterns.

deviation_metric.answer: Age- and sex-specific normative z-scores per metric; analysis of extreme values at |z| > 1.96 (approx. 2.5th/97.5th percentiles)
deviation_metric.reason: They compute z-scores from normative models, average by eye, and test enrichment of extreme tails using chi-squared.
deviation_metric.supporting_text: analyses on z-scores ... z-scores from the left and right eye were averaged ... we estimated the percentage of individuals above and below 1.96 standard deviations ... chi-squared tests

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Group comparisons of deviation (z) scores across diagnoses vs HC with effect sizes (Cohen's d) and chi-squared tests for enrichment of extreme (|z|>1.96) values; robustness analyses via covariate-adjusted mixed models including BMI, smoking, alcohol, diabetes, and socioeconomic status.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: SZ and BD show accelerated, disorder-specific retinal thinning relative to normative expectations (largest in SZ), while MDD shows no robust thinning; RNFL shows no consistent differences.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Macular thickness: combined patients d = -0.25 (~ -3.93 μm, p < 0.0001); SZ d = -0.41 (~ -6.97 μm, p < 0.0001); BD d = -0.20 (~ -3.00 μm, p = 0.0025); MDD d = -0.08 (~ -1.11 μm, p = 0.455). RNFL: no significant differences (e.g., SZ d = -0.10, p = 0.275). GC-IPL: combined d = -0.14 (~ -1.02 μm, p = 0.0026); SZ d = -0.19 (~ -1.38 μm, p = 0.0069); BD d = -0.12 (~ -0.89 μm, p = 0.0407); MDD non-significant. Infranormal enrichment: macular 4.65% patients vs 2.03% HC (X²=17.65, p=0.0003); GC-IPL 4.83% vs 2.35% (X²=13.70, p=0.0002); RNFL none.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Normative models focus on mid-to-late lifespan due to UKBB age range; lack of longitudinal/repeated measures limits inference on individual trajectories.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Sex- and laterality-specific GAMLSS models; left/right z-scores averaged; distribution family chosen via 5-fold 80/20 CV; robustness checks included extended cardiovascular covariates and mixed-effects analyses for repeated eye measures.

general_notes.general_notes: OCT acquisition details: 6×6 mm raster, 128 B-scans × 512 A-scans, ~3.7 s; Topcon segmentation of 9 intraretinal boundaries (processing ~120 s/image). QC used UKBB fields 28552, 28553 and excluded eye disorders (6148). Note: Abstract lists BD N=256 but Methods/Table 1 report BD N=265; we used 265 from Methods/Table 1.
